recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Future valueset-trusted-expansion wording or status cleanup should be handled in HL7/fhir-extensions; no FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-23785.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab issue for R5 requesting updated valueset-trusted-expansion text: if valueset-authoritativeSource cannot provide a valid expansion, the extension identifies the base URL of a FHIR server that is an alternate trusted source for obtaining a value set expansion, potentially through ValueSet $expand or a ValueSet endpoint returning a persisted expansion, and should only be used when the authoritative source lacks a FHIR service capable of generating or returning a valid FHIR value set expansion.
initial_application: No core commit message explicitly named FHIR-23785. Core commit 9fca6ca36fefa544491b1efc7fdb1530333ed78b applied the FHIR-23785 comment text to source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml along with the companion url datatype change, that commit was reverted, and 054eabf3116825c0f65107fedff6668447bf43a1 re-applied the same change. Later commit ade907ca5b1bc08efb093bc524c5b00bdc7fa5ac applied FHIR-27028 by replacing the broader FHIR-23785 wording with endpoint/base-URL wording, and dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension StructureDefinitions from core.
additional_context: Current core source has no active valueset-trusted-expansion StructureDefinition in source/fhir.ini and only retains OID registrations for valueset-authoritativeSource and valueset-trusted-expansion in source/oids.ini. The owning artifact is now /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml, which reflects later FHIR-27028 endpoint wording and FHIR-40707 definition/description clarification. The combined branch already contains external-repo audit commits for related FHIR-27848 and FHIR-27028.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined FHIR-core branch. No core source was changed because editing or re-adding the extension StructureDefinition in core would be the wrong repository boundary, and the current wording must be interpreted through later approved FHIR-27028 and FHIR-40707 decisions.
